description.value:
As a bonus action, you can spend one minute in a defensive stance. As part of that bonus action, and again as a bonus action on later turns, you may cast the saber ward power. Whenever you do, you gain a number of special reactions equal to your proficiency bonus, usable only to cast the saber reflect force power.

The stance ends early if you're incapacitated or killed. You must finish a long rest before using this feature again.
